ns2:section.sectionTitle: Adv. Data Sci & Python for Fin
ns2:section.sectionText: Advanced Data Science & Python. This advanced course in Python and data science will cover concepts such as 1. Advanced data cleaning and preparation, regular expressions, text and sentiment extraction. 2.Pandas working with large datasets and best practices (adv cleaning, merge, shape, etc). 3.Fundamentals of Web scrapping and extracting data from APIs. 4.Working with DateTime types and time series data.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Finance -UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, MS: Finance - UIUC, or MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC.
